results.title: Real nutrition label: serving arithmetic
results.source: Real FDA/Wikimedia nutrition label image; OCR plus arithmetic reasoning. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FDA_Nutrition_Facts_Label_2016.png

To find out how many calories and how much sodium are in two servings, we need to multiply the values for one serving by two.

Calories:
- One serving has 230 calories.
- Two servings will have \(2 \times 230 = 460\) calories.

Sodium:
- One serving has 160 mg of sodium.
- Two servings will have \(2 \times 160 = 320\) mg of sodium.

So, two servings will have 460 calories and 320 mg of sodium.
